headlines.title: 中共中央政治局会议：深化资本市场投融资综合改革，提升资本市场韧性和信心
headlines.summary: 会议强调，要切实筑牢安全屏障。稳定房地产市场，实施好一揽子化债方案，扎实推进地方中小金融机构改革化险、减量提质。深化资本市场投融资综合改革，提升资本市场韧性和信心。深入排查整治各类风险隐患，坚决遏制重特大事故发生。加强对病险水库、江河堤防、山洪和地质灾害危险区、城市低洼易涝点等隐患排查治理，扎实做好防汛应急抢险救灾各项工作，全力维护人民群众生命财产安全。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: A Politburo meeting stressed deepening comprehensive reforms in capital market investment and financing to enhance market resilience and confidence.
headlines.summary_en: The meeting stressed the need to build a solid safety barrier, stabilize the real estate market, implement a package of debt resolution plans, push forward reform and risk mitigation of local small and medium financial institutions to reduce quantity and improve quality, deepen comprehensive reforms in capital market investment and financing to enhance resilience and confidence, thoroughly investigate and rectify various risks and hazards, resolutely prevent major accidents, strengthen risk checks on dangerous reservoirs, river embankments, mountain flood and geological disaster zones, low-lying urban areas prone to waterlogging, and make solid efforts in flood control, emergency response, and disaster relief to protect people's lives and property. (Xinhua)

headlines.title: NBS: China’s 'three-new' economy value added 25.79 trillion yuan in 2025, 18.39% of GDP
headlines.summary: The National Bureau of Statistics said China’s three-new economy (new industries, new business forms and new models) generated 25.79 trillion yuan of value added in 2025, up 6.2% at current prices—2.2 percentage points faster than nominal GDP—and accounted for 18.39% of GDP, a 0.
headlines.title_zh: 国家统计局：2025年中国'三新'经济增加值达25.79万亿元，占GDP比重18.39%
headlines.summary_zh: 国家统计局数据显示，2025年中国三新经济（新产业、新业态、新商业模式）增加值达25.79万亿元，按现价计算同比增长6.2%，较名义GDP增速快2.2个百分点，占GDP比重为18.39%，较上年提升0.

headlines.title_en: A Politburo meeting emphasized accelerating the transition from old to new growth drivers and implementing a more proactive fiscal policy and a moderately accommodative monetary policy.
headlines.summary_en: The Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee held a meeting on July 30, stressing that for the second half of the year's economic work, we must adhere to Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, maintain the general principle of seeking progress while maintaining stability, fully and accurately implement the new development philosophy, accelerate the construction of a new development pattern, better coordinate domestic and international situations, balance development and security, persist in deepening reforms and opening up, accelerate the transformation of old and new growth drivers, implement a more proactive fiscal policy and moderately accommodative monetary policy, fully utilize existing policy effectiveness, promptly formulate pragmatic incremental policies, increase counter-cyclical adjustments, expand domestic demand, optimize supply, ensure and improve people's livelihoods, enhance development momentum, stimulate social vitality, promote sustained high-quality economic development, and strive for a good start to the 15th Five-Year Plan. headlines.title: 世界黄金协会：二季度中国央行购金步伐明显加快，累计增持33吨
headlines.summary: 世界黄金协会：中国人民银行仍是全球最活跃的官方黄金买家之一，已连续20个月购金，创下历史最长连增周期。继一季度增持7吨后，二季度中国央行购金步伐明显加快，累计增持33吨，创下2023年四季度以来最大季度购金规模。截至6月末，中国官方黄金储备达2,346吨，占外汇储备总额的8%。

headlines.title_en: The World Gold Council said the People's Bank of China accelerated its gold purchases in the second quarter, adding a total of 33 tonnes.
headlines.summary_en: World Gold Council: The People's Bank of China remains one of the world's most active official gold buyers, having purchased gold for 20 consecutive months, setting a record for the longest continuous buying cycle. After adding 7 tonnes in Q1, the PBOC significantly accelerated its purchases in Q2, adding 33 tonnes, the largest quarterly purchase since Q4 2023. As of end-June, China's official gold reserves reached 2,346 tonnes, accounting for 8% of total foreign exchange reserves.

headlines.title: Singapore-based investors now the top non-local buyers of Hong Kong office assets
headlines.summary:
Singapore-based investors have become the largest group of non-local buyers of commercial properties in Hong Kong, drawn by the sizeable correction in the prices of distressed assets amid a slump in the city’s office segment, according to Colliers.

headlines.title_zh: 新加坡投资者现已成为香港写字楼资产的最大海外买家
headlines.summary_zh: 高力国际数据显示，新加坡投资者已成为香港商业地产的最大非本地买家群体，受惠于香港写字楼市场低迷期间不良资产价格大幅回调的吸引。鉴于写字楼资产价格仍处低位，未来数月新加坡资金需求预计将保持稳定。

headlines.title_en: The Politburo held a meeting to analyze and study the current economic situation and economic work.
headlines.summary_en: [The Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee Holds Meeting to Analyze and Study Current Economic Situation and Economic Work] The Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee held a meeting on July 30, deciding to convene the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee in Beijing this October, with the main agenda being the Political Bureau reporting work to the Central Committee and studying several major issues on persistently advancing full and rigorous Party governance. The meeting analyzed and studied the current economic situation and deployed economic work for the second half of the year. General Secretary Xi Jinping presided over the meeting. The meeting emphasized building a solid safety barrier, stabilizing the real estate market, implementing a package of debt resolution plans, pushing forward reform and risk mitigation of local small and medium financial institutions to reduce quantity and improve quality, and deepening comprehensive reforms in capital market investment and financing to enhance resilience and confidence.

headlines.title: 中共中央政治局会议：扎实推进“六张网”规划建设
headlines.summary: 会议强调，要有效扩大国内需求，适应不同群体消费需求扩大优质供给，挖掘服务消费潜力。扎实推进“六张网”规划建设。加快现代化产业体系建设，加强对基础研究的长期稳定支持，深入实施“人工智能+”行动，发展智能经济新形态，完善人工智能治理体系。积极推动前沿技术突破和未来产业发展，着力打造新兴支柱产业，持续推动传统产业改造升级。（新华社）

headlines.title: 世界黄金协会：预计黄金投资需求仍将保持积极态势
headlines.summary: 世界黄金协会报告指出，预计在2026年剩余时间内，投资需求将成为黄金需求增长的主要动力，并日益受到场外交易活动和亚洲投资需求的支撑。央行仍将作为重要黄金买家。高金价将继续压制金饰需求量，但金矿产量和回收金供应量的反应预计将较为温和。预计2026年余下时间内，黄金投资需求仍将保持积极态势。场外交易活动和亚洲投资需求预计将发挥更大作用，而西方黄金ETF资金流或继续对美债实际收益率、美联储货币政策预期及美元走势保持敏感。尽管消费者支出金额仍相对具有韧性，但高金价将继续压制金饰需求量；科技用金需求有望进一步受益于人工智能投资，不过下行风险正在累积。

headlines.title_en: The World Gold Council expects gold investment demand to remain positive.
headlines.summary_en: World Gold Council report indicates that investment demand is expected to become the primary driver of gold demand growth for the remainder of 2026, increasingly supported by OTC trading activity and Asian investment demand. Central banks will remain important gold buyers. High gold prices will continue to suppress jewelry demand, but reactions in mine production and recycled gold supply are expected to be moderate. Gold investment demand is expected to remain positive for the rest of 2026. OTC trading activity and Asian investment demand are expected to play a larger role, while Western gold ETF flows may remain sensitive to US Treasury real yields, Fed monetary policy expectations, and the US dollar. Although consumer spending remains relatively resilient, high gold prices will continue to suppress jewelry demand; technology-related gold demand may further benefit from AI investment, but downside risks are accumulating.

headlines.title: 世界黄金协会：二季度全球央行及其他官方机构合计净增黄金储备同比增长62%
headlines.summary: 世界黄金协会发布的2026年二季度《全球黄金需求趋势报告》显示，二季度，全球央行及其他官方机构合计净增黄金储备289吨，同比增长62%，多个国家央行的购金活动均有所回升。但受一季度的疲软拖累，上半年全球央行购金需求略低于近年来的高位水平。世界黄金协会发布的《2026年全球央行黄金储备调研》显示，45%的受访央行预计未来一年内将增加其自身黄金储备，这凸显了黄金在官方储备中长期稳定的重要地位。

headlines.title_en: The World Gold Council said that in the second quarter, global central banks and other official institutions added 62% more net gold reserves year-on-year.
headlines.summary_en: The World Gold Council's Q2 2026 Global Gold Demand Trends report shows that central banks and other official institutions added a net 289 tonnes of gold to their reserves in Q2, up 62% year-on-year, with gold purchases by several countries' central banks picking up. However, dragged down by a weak Q1, global central bank gold demand in the first half was slightly below recent highs. The WGC's 2026 Central Bank Gold Reserves Survey indicates that 45% of surveyed central banks plan to increase their gold reserves over the next year, highlighting gold's long-term stable role in official reserves.

headlines.summary: 会议强调，要切实筑牢安全屏障。稳定房地产市场，实施好一揽子化债方案，扎实推进地方中小金融机构改革化险、减量提质。深化资本市场投融资综合改革，提升资本市场韧性和信心。深入排查整治各类风险隐患，坚决遏制重特大事故发生。加强对病险水库、江河堤防、山洪和地质灾害危险区、城市低洼易涝点等隐患排查治理，扎实做好防汛应急抢险救灾各项工作，全力维护人民群众生命财产安全。（新华社）
